2123099932978528514.en_summary: OpenAI reveals AI-driven chip design breakthrough with AMD, achieving up to 14% PPA improvements on GPU IP, and announces new GPT-Synopsys development partnership.
2123099932978528514.zh_summary: OpenAI 揭示與 AMD 的 AI 驅動晶片設計突破，在 GPU IP 上實現高達 14% 的 PPA 改進，並宣布新的 GPT-Synopsys 開發合作夥伴關係。

2123097286486179918.en_summary: Microsoft is the first to announce using Intel Foundry's EMIB advanced packaging for its Azure silicon, securing multi-year Xeon CPU supply including Diamond Rapids, and expanding on CXL memory, QuickAssist and TDX. Existing optimizations deliver up to 2.3x performance and 2.5x faster SQL backups.
2123097286486179918.zh_summary: 微軟是首家宣布使用英特爾 Foundry 的 EMIB 先進封裝技術於其 Azure 矽片的公司，並確保包括 Diamond Rapids 在內的多年 Xeon CPU 供應，同時擴展 CXL 記憶體、QuickAssist 和 TDX 工作。現有優化可提供高達 2.3 倍效能及 2.5 倍更快的 SQL 備份。

2123097029966778734.en_summary: MSFT is tapping INTC EMIB packaging for Azure chips and securing multiyear Xeon supply including Diamond Rapids. With NVDA saying CPU demand far outstrips supply, Intel can win on packaging and capacity even before closing the performance gap with AMD.
2123097029966778734.zh_summary: MSFT 正採用 INTC 的 EMIB 封裝技術用於其 Azure 晶片，並確保包括 Diamond Rapids 在內的多年 Xeon 供應。由於 NVDA 表示 CPU 需求遠超供應，英特爾可在縮小與 AMD 的效能差距前，在封裝與產能方面取勝。

2123096677099962447.en_summary: (Reposted by @KevInvestingYT) $NVDA stock is down despite beat and raise because they didn’t file 10Q with earnings (red flag), claimed zero China sales which is doubted, large holders likely unconvinced after calls, long squeeze ongoing. Concerns include competition, Neo clouds financing issues, higher DSOs, SEC/DOJ overhang, and macro worries on AI buildout credit. Market doesn’t believe forward forecasts.
2123096677099962447.zh_summary: （由 @KevInvestingYT 轉發）$NVDA 股價在業績超預期並上調指引後仍下跌，原因是未與財報同時提交 10Q（紅旗），聲稱對中國零銷售遭質疑，大股東通話後可能不信服，長擠壓持續。擔憂包括競爭、Neo 雲端融資問題、應收帳款天數上升、SEC/DOJ 調查陰影，以及對 AI 建設信貸的宏觀憂慮。市場不相信前瞻預測。
